entries.zh: 大学档案中有一份陆军数学研究中心研讨会通知。

entries.en: The photograph shows boats moored along the Amstel.
entries.zh: 照片中，几艘船停泊在阿姆斯特尔河岸边。

entries.en: The bibliography includes an AMTA publication.
entries.zh: 参考文献中有一份美国按摩治疗协会出版物。

entries.en: The radar glossary expands AMTI as airborne moving target indication.
entries.zh: 雷达词汇表把AMTI展开为机载动目标显示。

entries.en: Her ambition was to design a library that everyone could use.
entries.zh: 她的志向是设计一座人人都能使用的图书馆。

entries.en: The table gives atomic masses in amu.
entries.zh: 表中以原子质量单位列出原子质量。

entries.meaningZh: AMusD：原资料中的音乐博士学位缩写
entries.en: The old programme prints AMusD after the conductor's name.
entries.zh: 旧节目单在指挥姓名后印有音乐博士学位缩写。

entries.meaningZh: Amycin：原资料中的历史药品名称
entries.en: The pharmacy archive keeps an Amycin label.
entries.zh: 药学档案保存着一张Amycin标签。

entries.meaningZh: amygdaline：杏仁形的；与扁桃体有关的
entries.en: The anatomy glossary explains amygdaline as almond-shaped.
entries.zh: 解剖学词汇表把amygdaline解释为杏仁形的。

entries.meaningZh: amygdalectomy：扁桃体切除术的旧用法
entries.en: The surgical-history glossary uses amygdalectomy for tonsil removal.
entries.zh: 外科史词汇表用amygdalectomy表示扁桃体切除术。

entries.meaningZh: amygdalothrypsis：扁桃体压碎术的历史名称
entries.en: The history-of-surgery index includes amygdalothrypsis.
entries.zh: 外科史索引列有扁桃体压碎术。

entries.meaningZh: amygdalothrypsis：扁桃体压碎术的历史名称
entries.en: The museum caption preserves the term amygdalothrypsis.
entries.zh: 博物馆说明牌保留了扁桃体压碎术这一名称。

entries.meaningZh: amylaceum：拉丁语的淀粉样的，中性形式
entries.en: The Latin glossary explains amylaceum as starchy.
entries.zh: 拉丁语词汇表把amylaceum解释为淀粉样的。

entries.en: The medical historian lists amylenization among obsolete anaesthetic terms.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者把戊烯麻醉列为过时的麻醉术语。

entries.meaningZh: amylis：旧药学拉丁语中的戊基词形
entries.en: The historical nomenclature note gives amylis beside the English form amyl.
entries.zh: 历史命名笔记把amylis与英语形式amyl并列。

entries.en: The pigment-name index includes amylocyanin.
entries.zh: 色素名称索引中列有淀粉蓝素。

entries.en: The food-history catalogue lists Amyloin as a starch-derived product name.
entries.zh: 食品史目录把Amyloin列为淀粉衍生产品名。

entries.meaningZh: amylomycin：原资料中的旧生化名称，精确身份未确认
entries.en: The proofreader queried amylomycin because the source gloss was unclear.
entries.zh: 校对员因原释义不清而对amylomycin提出了疑问。

entries.en: The historical protein index lists amyloprolamine.
entries.zh: 历史蛋白质索引列有麦蛋白这一旧名。

entries.en: The enzyme glossary lists starch synthase.
entries.zh: 酶词汇表列有淀粉合成酶。

entries.en: The historical enzyme index cross-references amylzyme to amylase.
entries.zh: 历史酶索引把amylzyme交叉指向淀粉酶。

entries.meaningZh: amyotaxy：肌肉协调障碍的旧名称
entries.en: The neurological-history glossary includes amyotaxy.
entries.zh: 神经学史词汇表中列有肌肉协调障碍这一旧名。

entries.en: The figure labels the amyrin peak separately from the other peaks.
entries.zh: 图中把香树脂醇峰与其他峰分别标出。

entries.en: The old glossary uses amyxis for a scratch or scarification.
entries.zh: 旧词汇表用amyxis表示划痕或划破。

entries.en: Andrew offered to carry the folded table.
entries.zh: 安德鲁主动提出搬那张折叠桌。

entries.en: Could we have another chair for the visitor?
entries.zh: 能再给访客加一把椅子吗？

entries.meaningZh: Anabaena：项圈藻属，蓝细菌类群名称
entries.en: The biology chart labels Anabaena among the cyanobacteria.
entries.zh: 生物学图表把项圈藻属列在蓝细菌中。

entries.meaningZh: anabion：同化占优势的生物的旧称
entries.en: The old biology key labels the growth-dominant organism an anabion.
entries.zh: 旧生物学分类表把同化生长占优势的生物标为anabion。

entries.meaningZh: anabolergy：同化力或合成代谢能力的旧称
entries.en: The historical physiology glossary defines anabolergy as anabolic capacity.
entries.zh: 历史生理学词汇表把anabolergy解释为合成代谢能力。

entries.meaningZh: anabolin：合成代谢产物的旧名称
entries.en: The historical biochemistry table lists anabolin as a product name.
entries.zh: 历史生物化学表把anabolin列为产物名。

entries.en: The optics collection includes an anacamptometer.
entries.zh: 光学收藏中有一台反射测量仪。

entries.meaningZh: anacatadidymus：腰部相连的联胎旧名称
entries.en: The medical-history index retains anacatadidymus as a descriptive heading.
entries.zh: 医学史索引保留了anacatadidymus作为描述性标题。

entries.meaningZh: anaceliadelphus：胸或上腹相连的联胎旧名称
entries.en: The historical anatomy glossary includes anaceliadelphus.
entries.zh: 历史解剖学词汇表列有anaceliadelphus。

entries.meaningZh: Anachoropteridales：回卷蕨目，古植物分类名
entries.en: The fossil-plant chart includes Anachoropteridales.
entries.zh: 古植物图表列有回卷蕨目。

entries.en: The old physics syllabus lists anaclastics under optics.
entries.zh: 旧物理大纲把anaclastics列在光学之下。

entries.meaningZh: anacoluthic：句法中断或前后结构不衔接的
entries.en: The narrator's anacoluthic sentences convey panic.
entries.zh: 叙述者前后结构断裂的句子传达出惊慌。

entries.meaningZh: anachoresis：微生物在局部组织聚集的旧术语
entries.en: The dental-history glossary includes anachoresis.
entries.zh: 牙科学史词汇表列有anachoresis。

entries.en: The plant diagram marks an anaerobic tank.
entries.zh: 设施示意图标出了一个厌氧处理池。

entries.meaningZh: anadiagenesis：前进成岩作用的旧名称
entries.en: The geology glossary places anadiagenesis among diagenetic terms.
entries.zh: 地质词汇表把anadiagenesis列在成岩作用术语中。

entries.meaningZh: Anadolu：安纳托利亚的土耳其语名称
entries.en: The Turkish map labels the region Anadolu.
entries.zh: 土耳其语地图把该地区标为Anadolu。

entries.meaningZh: anaerobiase：厌氧蛋白分解相关酶的旧名称
entries.en: The historical enzyme index includes anaerobiase.
entries.zh: 历史酶索引中列有anaerobiase。

entries.meaningZh: anaerophyte：旧分类中的厌氧植物或类植物生物名
entries.en: The historical botany text uses anaerophyte as a category label.
entries.zh: 历史植物学教材把anaerophyte用作类别标签。

entries.en: The old drug dictionary cross-references anaesthesine to benzocaine.
entries.zh: 旧药物词典把anaesthesine交叉指向苯佐卡因。

entries.meaningZh: ANAG：急性窄角型青光眼的旧缩写
entries.en: The historical glossary expands ANAG as acute narrow-angle glaucoma.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把ANAG展开为急性窄角型青光眼。

entries.meaningZh: anagen：毛发生长周期中的生长期
entries.en: The hair-cycle diagram colours the anagen phase in green.
entries.zh: 毛发周期示意图用绿色标出了生长期。

entries.en: The hallway was papered with Anaglypta.
entries.zh: 走廊贴着Anaglypta压花墙纸。

entries.meaningZh: anagocytic：抑制细胞再生的旧形容词
entries.en: The historical pathology glossary labels anagocytic as a specialised adjective.
entries.zh: 历史病理学词汇表把anagocytic标为专业形容词。

entries.en: The old pharmacology glossary explains anagotoxic as antitoxic.
entries.zh: 旧药理学词汇表把anagotoxic解释为抗毒的。

entries.meaningZh: Anahaemin：历史肝提取物制剂名称
entries.en: The medical-history catalogue files the Anahaemin pamphlet with other early liver-extract literature.
entries.zh: 医学史目录把Anahaemin小册子与其他早期肝提取物文献编在一起。

entries.meaningZh: Anaira：原资料中的柯桠树属名称
entries.en: The botanical index preserves the genus name Anaira.
entries.zh: 植物学索引保留了Anaira这一属名。

entries.meaningZh: anakinesis：高能化合物合成相关的旧术语
entries.en: The historical biochemistry glossary uses anakinesis for an energy-related synthetic process.
entries.zh: 历史生物化学词汇表用anakinesis指与能量有关的合成过程。

entries.en: The old glossary pairs anakinetomeric with an energy-related noun.
entries.zh: 旧词汇表把anakinetomeric与一个能量相关名词配对。

entries.meaningZh: Anakrom：硅藻土型色谱载体名称
entries.en: The historical chromatography catalogue lists Anakrom as a support material.
entries.zh: 历史色谱目录把Anakrom列为载体材料。

entries.en: The geological description records analcimization of the rock.
entries.zh: 地质描述记录了岩石的方沸石化。

entries.en: The petrography notes use the alternative spelling analcitization.
entries.zh: 岩相学笔记使用analcitization这一另一拼写形式。

entries.en: The novel uses analepsis to reveal the narrator's childhood.
entries.zh: 小说通过倒叙揭示叙述者的童年。

entries.meaningZh: Analgesin：原资料中的历史药品名称
entries.en: The pharmacy archive retains the name Analgesin on the packet.
entries.zh: 药学档案在包装上保留了Analgesin名称。

entries.meaningZh: Analginum：安乃近的拉丁化药名形式
entries.en: The historical drug glossary cross-references Analginum to metamizole.
entries.zh: 历史药物词汇表把Analginum交叉指向安乃近。

entries.meaningZh: anallachrom：原资料中的七叶亭酸旧名称
entries.en: The historical chemical index preserves anallachrom as an older name.
entries.zh: 历史化学索引把anallachrom保留为旧名。

entries.en: The education study examines adult analphabetism.
entries.zh: 教育研究探讨了成年人的不识字现象。

entries.meaningZh: analysin：旧资料中的枯草杆菌相关产物名称
entries.en: The historical product index preserves the spelling analysin.
entries.zh: 历史产物索引保留了analysin这一拼写。

entries.en: The report identifies the analyte but gives no concentration.
entries.zh: 报告指明了待测物，但没有给出浓度。

entries.en: The geological catalogue records an anamesite sample.
entries.zh: 地质目录记录了一件细玄岩样品。

entries.en: The cinematographer used an anamorphic lens for the wide image.
entries.zh: 摄影师使用变形镜头拍摄宽幅画面。

entries.en: The evolution diagram contrasts anagenesis with branching change.
entries.zh: 演化示意图把谱系内部演变与分支变化作了对比。

entries.meaningZh: anapeirean：原资料中的太平洋相关旧地质词形
entries.en: The geologist kept anapeirean in quotation marks in the transcription.
entries.zh: 地质学家转录时将anapeirean保留在引号中。

entries.meaningZh: anapetia：扩张的旧医学名称，原资料指血管扩张
entries.en: The medical-history glossary uses anapetia for dilation.
entries.zh: 医学史词汇表用anapetia表示扩张。

entries.meaningZh: anaphrodite：缺乏性欲者的旧式医学称谓
entries.en: The historian notes that anaphrodite was once used as a medical label.
entries.zh: 历史学家指出，anaphrodite曾被用作医学标签。

entries.meaningZh: anaphylactogenesis：致敏或过敏反应形成的旧名称
entries.en: The historical allergy glossary distinguishes anaphylactogenesis from the later reaction.
entries.zh: 历史过敏学词汇表区分了致敏形成与后来的反应。

entries.meaningZh: anaphylatoxis：过敏毒素性反应的旧名称
entries.en: The historical immunology glossary includes anaphylatoxis.
entries.zh: 历史免疫学词汇表列有过敏毒素性反应这一旧名。

entries.en: The old glossary uses anaphysis for recovery or restoration.
entries.zh: 旧词汇表用anaphysis表示恢复或复原。

entries.meaningZh: anaplerosis：回补作用；补充代谢循环中间物
entries.en: The biochemistry diagram labels the replenishing step anaplerosis.
entries.zh: 生物化学示意图把回补步骤标为anaplerosis。

entries.meaningZh: Anoplotheriidae：一科已灭绝哺乳动物的科名
entries.en: The fossil index lists Anoplotheriidae among extinct mammal families.
entries.zh: 化石索引把Anoplotheriidae列在已灭绝哺乳动物科中。

entries.en: The medical-history exhibition includes a reference to anapnotherapy.
entries.zh: 医学史展览提到了吸入疗法这一旧名。

entries.meaningZh: Anara：原资料中的历史药品名称
entries.en: The pharmacy archive holds an Anara label.
entries.zh: 药学档案保存着一张Anara标签。

entries.en: The butterfly diagram labels the specialised scales androconia.
entries.zh: 蝴蝶示意图把这些特化鳞片标为香鳞。

entries.en: The optics collection includes an anascope.
entries.zh: 光学收藏中有一件正像观察镜。

entries.en: The historical medical glossary cross-references anaspadias to epispadias.
entries.zh: 历史医学词汇表把anaspadias交叉指向尿道上裂。

entries.en: The poet's anastrophic word order delays the main verb.
entries.zh: 诗人的倒装词序把主要动词推迟到后面。

entries.en: The geological collection includes an anatectite sample.
entries.zh: 地质收藏中有一件重熔混合岩样品。

entries.meaningZh: anathermal：增温期的，旧气候学用语
entries.en: The historical climate chart labels an anathermal interval.
entries.zh: 历史气候图标出了一段增温期。

entries.meaningZh: anathreptic：滋养或促进组织恢复的旧用语
entries.en: The old glossary explains anathreptic as a nourishment-related adjective.
entries.zh: 旧词汇表把anathreptic解释为与滋养有关的形容词。

entries.en: The textbook uses clear anatomic drawings.
entries.zh: 教材采用了清楚的解剖图。

entries.en: The medical-history catalogue includes anatripsis.
entries.zh: 医学史目录列有揉擦疗法。

entries.en: The historical glossary expands ANB as aspiration-needle biopsy.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把ANB展开为针吸活检。

entries.meaningZh: anbury：植物根肿或瘤状物的旧名称
entries.en: The old gardening book uses anbury for swollen roots.
entries.zh: 旧园艺书用anbury指肿大的根部。

entries.meaningZh: ancelia：安萨利阿布，旧纺织名称
entries.en: The fabric archive includes a swatch labelled ancelia.
entries.zh: 面料档案中有一块标为安萨利阿布的布样。

entries.en: The parasitology index lists Ancylostoma as a genus.
entries.zh: 寄生虫学索引把钩口线虫属列为一个属名。

entries.en: The botanical description calls the flattened stem ancipital.
entries.zh: 植物学描述把这根扁平茎称为二棱的。

entries.en: The methods section reports an ANCOVA.
entries.zh: 方法部分报告了一项协方差分析。

entries.en: The zoological classification chart includes Ancylostomatidae.
entries.zh: 动物分类图中列有钩口科。

entries.en: The medical-history index has an entry for hookworm anaemia.
entries.zh: 医学史索引有一项钩虫相关贫血条目。

entries.en: She packed a torch, spare batteries, and even a small radio.
entries.zh: 她带了手电筒、备用电池，甚至还有一台小收音机。

entries.en: Andone put the signed forms in the correct envelope.
entries.zh: 安多内把签好的表格装进正确的信封。

entries.en: The pharmacy archive contains an Andelin label.
entries.zh: 药学档案中有一张Andelin标签。

entries.en: The geological catalogue records an andesinite specimen.
entries.zh: 地质目录记录了一件中长岩标本。

entries.meaningZh: ANDL：陆军核防护研究所的历史缩写
entries.en: The archive lists an ANDL report by title.
entries.zh: 档案按标题列出一份陆军核防护研究所报告。

entries.meaningZh: andogenin：原资料中的桉豆配基名称
entries.en: The chemical-name index retains andogenin.
entries.zh: 化学名称索引保留了andogenin。

entries.en: The old mineral label reads andrewsite.
entries.zh: 旧矿物标签写着羟绿铜矿这一旧名。

entries.en: The medical-history syllabus lists andriatry as a specialist term.
entries.zh: 医学史教学大纲把andriatry列为专门术语。

entries.meaningZh: andro：雄烯二酮的非正式简称
entries.en: The historical sports report explains andro as a shortened name for androstenedione.
entries.zh: 历史体育报道把andro解释为雄烯二酮的简称。

entries.en: The butterfly diagram labels a single scent scale androconium.
entries.zh: 蝴蝶示意图把一枚香鳞标为androconium。

entries.meaningZh: androecy：纯雄性个体的状态或纯雄型性别表达
entries.en: The botanical glossary contrasts androecy with other sex-expression patterns.
entries.zh: 植物学词汇表把纯雄型与其他性别表达模式作了对比。

entries.meaningZh: androgenize：使产生雄激素效应；以雄激素处理
entries.en: The medical-history glossary marks androgenize as a technical verb.
entries.zh: 医学史词汇表把androgenize标为技术动词。

entries.en: The botanical index includes Andrographis.
entries.zh: 植物学索引列有穿心莲属。

entries.meaningZh: androgyneity：兼具男女特征的性质，旧用语
entries.en: The historian discusses how androgyneity was described in older texts.
entries.zh: 历史学家讨论了旧文献如何描述兼具男女特征的状态。

entries.en: The old pharmacy catalogue cross-references Androkin to androsterone.
entries.zh: 旧药学目录把Androkin交叉指向雄甾酮。

entries.en: The library catalogues the book under andrology.
entries.zh: 图书馆把这本书编在男科学类。

entries.meaningZh: andromerogon：雄核卵片，旧胚胎学术语
entries.en: The historical embryology diagram labels one fragment andromerogon.
entries.zh: 历史胚胎学示意图把其中一个片段标为雄核卵片。

entries.meaningZh: androphany：男性特征显现的旧名称
entries.en: The historical glossary treats androphany as a descriptive label rather than a modern diagnosis.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把androphany作为描述性标签，而不是现代诊断。

entries.meaningZh: androphonomania：杀人冲动的旧式法医名称
entries.en: The historian notes that androphonomania was once used in forensic writing.
entries.zh: 历史学家指出，androphonomania曾用于法医文献。

entries.meaningZh: androsymphysis：男性联胎的旧形态名称
entries.en: The medical-history index retains androsymphysis as a descriptive heading.
entries.zh: 医学史索引把androsymphysis保留为描述性标题。

entries.meaningZh: Andvari：安德瓦利，北欧神话中的矮人
entries.en: The story names the dwarf Andvari.
entries.zh: 故事把这个矮人称为安德瓦利。

entries.meaningZh: anectasis：肺未膨胀或原发肺不张的旧称
entries.en: The medical-history glossary cross-references anectasis to primary atelectasis.
entries.zh: 医学史词汇表把anectasis交叉指向原发性肺不张。

entries.en: The historical medical index includes anematosis.
entries.zh: 历史医学索引中列有全身性贫血这一旧名。

entries.en: The weather-instrument collection includes an anemobarometer.
entries.zh: 气象仪器收藏中有一台风速风压计。

entries.meaningZh: anemoclast：风成碎屑或风成碎屑岩
entries.en: The sedimentology glossary places anemoclast among wind-related terms.
entries.zh: 沉积学词汇表把anemoclast列在风成相关术语中。

entries.meaningZh: anemoclinometer：风倾角相关测量仪的旧名称
entries.en: The meteorological catalogue includes an anemoclinometer.
entries.zh: 气象目录中有一台风倾角测量仪。

entries.meaningZh: anemonsite：原资料中的混合长石旧名称
entries.en: The old mineral catalogue retains anemonsite.
entries.zh: 旧矿物目录保留了anemonsite。

entries.en: The old machinery drawing labels the starter anemostart.
entries.zh: 旧机械图把起动器标为anemostart。

entries.meaningZh: anempeiria：习得能力丧失的旧术语
entries.en: The historical psychology index includes anempeiria as a learning-related term.
entries.zh: 历史心理学索引把anempeiria列为学习相关术语。

entries.en: The medical historian left anencephaloneuria in the transcription.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者在转录中保留了anencephaloneuria。

entries.meaningZh: Anepitheliocystidia：原资料中的吸虫分类旧名
entries.en: The historical zoological chart lists Anepitheliocystidia.
entries.zh: 历史动物分类图列有Anepitheliocystidia。

entries.en: Her patience was unequaled among the volunteers.
entries.zh: 在志愿者中，她的耐心无与伦比。

entries.en: The weather-station museum displayed an aneroid barograph.
entries.zh: 气象站博物馆展出了一台空盒气压记录仪。

entries.en: The flavour-chemistry index lists anethole.
entries.zh: 风味化学索引列有茴香脑。

entries.meaningZh: anaesthetic spasm：麻醉期间的痉挛，描述性短语
entries.en: The historical case index uses the phrase anaesthetic spasm.
entries.zh: 历史病例索引使用了麻醉期间痉挛这一短语。

entries.en: The medical editor corrected the spelling of anesthetizing.
entries.zh: 医学编辑纠正了anesthetizing的拼写。

entries.meaningZh: aneugamy：非整倍体配合的旧名称
entries.en: The genetics glossary lists aneugamy as a mating-related term.
entries.zh: 遗传学词汇表把aneugamy列为配合相关术语。

entries.meaningZh: aneuthanasia：痛苦死亡或难死的旧名称
entries.en: The medical-history glossary contrasts aneuthanasia with the idea of an easy death.
entries.zh: 医学史词汇表把aneuthanasia与轻易死亡的观念作了对比。

entries.meaningZh: anfora：意大利历史容量单位或双耳罐名称
entries.en: The maritime archive lists wine quantities in anfora.
entries.zh: 海事档案以anfora列出葡萄酒数量。

entries.meaningZh: Angee：安吉，人名的非正式拼写
entries.en: Angee brought a spare bag for the books.
entries.zh: 安吉多带了一个装书的袋子。

entries.en: There were two Angelinas on the guest list, each with a different surname.
entries.zh: 宾客名单上有两位安吉莉娜，姓氏各不相同。

entries.meaningZh: anger-in：向内压抑或不外露的愤怒
entries.en: The psychology questionnaire has a section labelled anger-in.
entries.zh: 心理学问卷有一个标为内抑愤怒的部分。

entries.en: The medical index distinguishes angiocardiography from other imaging terms.
entries.zh: 医学索引把心血管造影与其他成像术语区分开。

entries.en: The historical glossary lists angioleukectasia among lymphatic terms.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把angioleukectasia列在淋巴相关术语中。

entries.en: The pathology glossary treats angioneuroma as a tumour name, not a word for pain.
entries.zh: 病理学词汇表把angioneuroma作为肿瘤名称，而不是疼痛用语。

entries.en: The imaging glossary distinguishes angioscopy from angiography.
entries.zh: 成像词汇表区分了血管镜检查与血管造影。

entries.en: The zoological description calls the narrow opening angiostomatous.
entries.zh: 动物学描述把这个狭窄开口称为狭口型。

entries.en: The historical medical glossary includes angiotelectasia.
entries.zh: 历史医学词汇表中列有毛细血管扩张这一旧名。

entries.en: The glossary notes that angiotension refers to pressure within a vessel.
entries.zh: 词汇表指出，angiotension指血管内部的压力。

entries.meaningZh: angkucanum：原资料中的挖花或刺绣工艺名称
entries.en: The textile-history catalogue preserves the name angkucanum.
entries.zh: 纺织史目录保留了angkucanum这一名称。

entries.en: The medical vocabulary exercise explains the modifier angle-closure.
entries.zh: 医学词汇练习解释了闭角型的这一修饰语。

entries.en: The costume inventory lists a length of anglet.
entries.zh: 服饰清单列出了一段白色花边带。

entries.en: The exhibition explores Anglo-German cultural exchange.
entries.zh: 展览探讨了英德文化交流。

entries.meaningZh: Anglo-Welsh：英格兰与威尔士相关的；威尔士英语文学的
entries.en: The course includes a section on Anglo-Welsh writing.
entries.zh: 课程有一部分介绍威尔士英语文学。

entries.meaningZh: Anglophonia：英语世界或英语文化空间的观念
entries.en: The essay uses Anglophonia to describe a shared English-speaking cultural space.
entries.zh: 文章用Anglophonia描述共享的英语文化空间。

entries.en: The geological map retains the older stage name Angoumian.
entries.zh: 地质图保留了安古米阶这一旧名称。

entries.en: The skull diagram labels the angulare along the lower jaw.
entries.zh: 头骨示意图在下颌处标出了隅骨。

entries.en: The old bird key describes the narrow bill as angustirostrate.
entries.zh: 旧鸟类检索表把狭窄的喙描述为狭喙型。

entries.en: The old inventory uses anh. beside anhydrous materials.
entries.zh: 旧清单在无水材料旁使用anh.这一缩写。

entries.meaningZh: anhedonic：快感缺失的；难以体验愉悦的
entries.en: The psychology glossary explains anhedonic without using it as a label for a person.
entries.zh: 心理学词汇表解释了快感缺失的，但没有用它给某个人贴标签。

entries.meaningZh: anhemothigmic：原资料中的血液接触相关词，规范义有冲突
entries.en: The editor queried anhemothigmic because its negative prefix conflicted with the gloss.
entries.zh: 编辑因否定前缀与释义冲突而对anhemothigmic提出疑问。

entries.meaningZh: anhydraemia：血液水分减少的旧名称
entries.en: The historical glossary distinguishes anhydraemia from anaemia.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表区分了血液水分减少与贫血。

entries.en: The materials archive retains anhydrock on an old sample label.
entries.zh: 材料档案在旧样品标签上保留了anhydrock。

entries.en: The historical alkaloid index includes anhydromuscarine.
entries.zh: 历史生物碱索引列有脱水毒蕈碱。

entries.en: The chemistry glossary contrasts anhydrosynthesis with hydrolysis.
entries.zh: 化学词汇表对比了脱水合成与水解。

entries.meaningZh: anianthus：白色短纤维石棉的旧名称
entries.en: The industrial-history index includes anianthus among old fibre names.
entries.zh: 工业史索引把anianthus列在旧纤维名称中。

entries.en: Anie placed the flowers in a tall glass vase.
entries.zh: 安妮把花插在一个高玻璃花瓶里。

entries.en: The historical pesticide index lists anilazine.
entries.zh: 历史农药索引中列有敌菌灵。

entries.meaningZh: anilest：anile的罕见最高级，衰老糊涂的
entries.en: The editor marked anilest as old-fashioned and potentially insulting.
entries.zh: 编辑把anilest标为过时且可能冒犯的用语。

entries.meaningZh: anilinctus：口肛接触的旧性学术语
entries.en: The editor labels anilinctus as an explicit sexual term.
entries.zh: 编辑把anilinctus标为明确的性行为术语。

entries.en: The zoological index lists Aniliidae as a snake family.
entries.zh: 动物学索引把Aniliidae列为蛇类的一个科。

entries.en: The score uses anim. to mean animato.
entries.zh: 乐谱用anim.表示活泼地演奏。

entries.en: The farm shop has a separate aisle for animal feed.
entries.zh: 农用品商店为动物饲料设有单独的通道。

entries.en: The policy document discusses alternatives to animal research.
entries.zh: 政策文件讨论了动物研究的替代方案。

entries.en: The article discusses public attitudes to animal testing.
entries.zh: 文章讨论了公众对动物试验的态度。

entries.meaningZh: animalist：追求身体享乐者的旧称
entries.en: The old essay uses animalist for someone devoted to bodily pleasures.
entries.zh: 旧随笔用animalist指沉迷身体享乐的人。

entries.en: The map shows the Animas River passing through the town.
entries.zh: 地图显示阿尼马斯河穿过这座城镇。

entries.en: The historical varnish catalogue lists animi among resins.
entries.zh: 历史清漆目录把animi列在树脂中。

entries.meaningZh: animize：使有生气；使生动，罕见用语
entries.en: The storyteller's vivid details seem to animize the wooden figures.
entries.zh: 讲故事者的生动细节仿佛让木偶活了起来。

entries.en: The letter was posted from Anini.
entries.zh: 信从阿尼尼寄出。

entries.meaningZh: anionotherapy：阴离子疗法的历史名称
entries.en: The medical historian discusses anionotherapy as a historical treatment concept.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者把阴离子疗法作为历史治疗观念讨论。

entries.en: The stratigraphic chart labels the interval Anisian.
entries.zh: 地层图把这一段标为安尼西阶。

entries.meaningZh: anisergy：不均衡作用的旧术语，原资料指血压不等
entries.en: The medical historian kept anisergy separate from modern diagnostic labels.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者把anisergy与现代诊断标签区分开。

entries.en: The ophthalmology glossary contrasts aniso-accommodation with equal accommodation.
entries.zh: 眼科学词汇表对比了两眼调节不等与调节相等。

entries.meaningZh: anisochromasia：着色不均；色素分布不均
entries.en: The histology glossary defines anisochromasia as unequal staining.
entries.zh: 组织学词汇表把anisochromasia解释为着色不均。

entries.meaningZh: anisodactylous：异趾型的，鸟足三趾向前一趾向后
entries.en: The bird-foot diagram shows an anisodactylous arrangement.
entries.zh: 鸟足示意图展示了异趾型排列。

entries.en: The comparative-anatomy glossary uses anisodonty for unequal teeth.
entries.zh: 比较解剖学词汇表用anisodonty表示牙齿大小不等。

entries.en: The medical glossary defines anisogynecomastia as asymmetric breast enlargement in males.
entries.zh: 医学词汇表把anisogynecomastia解释为男性乳房发育不对称。

entries.en: The botany glossary uses anisomery for unequal numbers of floral parts.
entries.zh: 植物学词汇表用anisomery表示花部数量不等。

entries.meaningZh: Anisomyaria：异柱类的旧软体动物分类名
entries.en: The old mollusc chart lists Anisomyaria as a group.
entries.zh: 旧软体动物分类图把Anisomyaria列为一组。

entries.en: The historical glossary uses anisorhythmia for irregular rhythm.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表用anisorhythmia表示节律不匀。

entries.en: The old clinical glossary distinguishes anisosphygmia from an absent pulse.
entries.zh: 旧临床词汇表区分了脉搏不匀与脉搏消失。

entries.meaningZh: anisoyl：茴香酰；甲氧基苯甲酰基
entries.en: The nomenclature diagram labels the anisoyl group.
entries.zh: 命名示意图标出了茴香酰基。

entries.en: The old naming table includes anisylidene as a substituent name.
entries.zh: 旧命名表把anisylidene列为取代基名称。

entries.en: The Spanish invitation uses aniversario for the anniversary celebration.
entries.zh: 西班牙语邀请函用aniversario表示周年庆典。

entries.meaningZh: Anka：安卡，阿拉伯传说中的鸟名
entries.en: The storyteller compared the legendary bird to Anka.
entries.zh: 讲故事者把这只传说中的鸟比作安卡。

entries.en: The geological cabinet contains an ankaratrite sample.
entries.zh: 地质柜里有一件橄榄霞岩样品。

entries.en: The neurology glossary explains ankle clonus as a rhythmic movement sign.
entries.zh: 神经学词汇表把踝阵挛解释为一种节律性运动体征。

entries.en: The sandal's ankle strap was too loose.
entries.zh: 这只凉鞋的踝带太松了。

entries.en: The historical medical glossary includes ankylocolpos.
entries.zh: 历史医学词汇表列有阴道闭锁这一旧名。

entries.en: The historical anatomical glossary includes ankylodere.
entries.zh: 历史解剖学词汇表列有颈部粘连这一旧名。

entries.en: The vocabulary exercise gives ankyloglossia as the medical term for tongue-tie.
entries.zh: 词汇练习把ankyloglossia列为舌系带过短的医学名称。

entries.meaningZh: ankylomerism：部分互相粘连的旧名称
entries.en: The historical glossary uses ankylomerism as a descriptive term for joined parts.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把ankylomerism作为部位相连的描述性术语。

entries.meaningZh: ankylotomy：关节强直松解术的旧称
entries.en: The surgical-history glossary places ankylotomy among terms for releasing joint stiffness.
entries.zh: 外科史词汇表把ankylotomy列在关节强直松解相关术语中。

entries.meaningZh: anti-invasin：抗侵袭素，旧免疫学名称
entries.en: The historical immunology diagram labels one component anti-invasin.
entries.zh: 历史免疫学示意图把一个成分标为抗侵袭素。

entries.en: The novel opens with news of a general amnesty.
entries.zh: 小说以大赦的消息开篇。

entries.en: The Annans invited us to a small family celebration.
entries.zh: 安南一家邀请我们参加小型家庭庆祝活动。

entries.en: The materials-history chapter describes annealing as a traditional process.
entries.zh: 材料史章节把退火描述为一种传统工艺。

entries.en: The French memoir is titled Les années.
entries.zh: 这部法语回忆录的标题意为那些年。

entries.meaningZh: annexment：附并或合并的行为，旧式用语
entries.en: The old legal record uses annexment for the addition of the land to the estate.
entries.zh: 旧法律记录用annexment表示把这片土地并入地产。

entries.en: The theologian compares an annihilationist with a defender of eternal punishment.
entries.zh: 神学家比较了灵魂毁灭说信奉者与永罚说支持者。

entries.en: The Annings kept the old photograph in a wooden box.
entries.zh: 安宁一家把旧照片保存在木盒里。

entries.meaningZh: annunciator：报警显示器或信号指示器
entries.en: The control panel has an annunciator for each alarm.
entries.zh: 控制面板为每项警报配有一个信号指示器。

entries.en: The membership fee is paid annually.
entries.zh: 会费每年缴纳一次。

entries.meaningZh: annuent：点头状的；下垂的，旧用语
entries.en: The old botany text calls the nodding flowers annuent.
entries.zh: 旧植物学教材把下垂的花称为annuent。

entries.en: The court was asked to annul the agreement.
entries.zh: 有人请求法院撤销这项协议。

entries.en: The surgical-history index includes annulorrhaphy.
entries.zh: 外科史索引列有环形缝合术。

entries.meaningZh: AnOC：旧电生理学中的阳极收缩标记
entries.en: The historical electrophysiology chart includes the label AnOC.
entries.zh: 历史电生理学图表中有AnOC这一标签。

entries.meaningZh: anocheiloschisis：上唇分裂的旧解剖名称
entries.en: The historical anatomy index uses anocheiloschisis as a descriptive heading.
entries.zh: 历史解剖学索引用anocheiloschisis作描述性标题。

entries.meaningZh: anoci-association：防止手术伤害性刺激的历史麻醉观念
entries.en: The medical-history chapter discusses anoci-association as an early anaesthetic concept.
entries.zh: 医学史章节把anoci-association作为早期麻醉观念讨论。

entries.meaningZh: anociation：原资料中的历史麻醉相关名称
entries.en: The surgical historian retains anociation in the quotation from the old text.
entries.zh: 外科史研究者在旧文引述中保留了anociation。

entries.en: The results table includes a column for anode efficiency.
entries.zh: 结果表有一栏列出阳极效率。

entries.en: The sign is made from anodized aluminum.
entries.zh: 这块标牌由阳极氧化铝材制成。

entries.en: The glossary distinguishes anodontia from the loss of teeth later in life.
entries.zh: 词汇表区分了先天性缺牙与后天牙齿脱落。

entries.meaningZh: anoedochium：精神病收容机构的历史名称
entries.en: The medical historian explains anoedochium as an old term for an asylum.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者把anoedochium解释为精神病收容机构的旧称。

entries.en: The old physiology glossary uses anomalotrophy for abnormal nutrition.
entries.zh: 旧生理学词汇表用anomalotrophy表示营养异常。

entries.meaningZh: anonacein：胡椒番荔枝碱的历史名称，依原资料
entries.en: The old alkaloid index preserves the name anonacein.
entries.zh: 旧生物碱索引保留了anonacein这一名称。

entries.en: The historical mosquito chart places Anophelini at the tribal level.
entries.zh: 历史蚊类分类图把按蚊族放在族这一等级。

entries.en: The medical historian notes that anorchus was used as a person-label in older texts.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者指出，旧文献曾把anorchus用于指称人。

entries.meaningZh: anosia：无疾病或健康状态的旧名称
entries.en: The historical glossary explains anosia as freedom from disease.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把anosia解释为无疾病状态。

entries.meaningZh: anothermic：旧海洋学中与深海均温层有关的词
entries.en: The old oceanographic chart labels one layer anothermic.
entries.zh: 旧海洋图表把其中一层标为anothermic。

entries.en: The reproductive-health glossary includes anovulation.
entries.zh: 生殖健康词汇表列有无排卵。

entries.meaningZh: anoxyscope：原资料中的需氧测量器具旧名
entries.en: The instrument-history catalogue retains the name anoxyscope.
entries.zh: 仪器史目录保留了anoxyscope这一名称。

entries.meaningZh: ANPA：美国报业出版商协会的历史简称
entries.en: The newspaper archive preserves an ANPA circular.
entries.zh: 报业档案保存着一份美国报业出版商协会通报。

entries.en: The agency published an ANPRM to invite early public comment.
entries.zh: 该机构发布了一份拟议规则预先通知，征求早期公众意见。

entries.en: Her letter conveyed the anguish of a long separation.
entries.zh: 她的信传达了长期分离的痛苦。

entries.en: The bibliography cites an ANRE energy report.
entries.zh: 参考文献引用了一份日本资源能源厅的能源报告。

entries.en: The old directory calls the ear specialist an aurist.
entries.zh: 旧名录把耳科专家称为aurist。

entries.en: The optics collection includes a refractometer.
entries.zh: 光学收藏中有一台折射仪。

entries.meaningZh: Ansett：安捷航空，历史航空公司名称
entries.en: The collection includes an old Ansett luggage tag.
entries.zh: 收藏中有一张旧安捷航空行李牌。

entries.en: The design note cites an ANSI standard.
entries.zh: 设计说明引用了一项美国国家标准协会标准。

entries.meaningZh: ANSP：韩国国家安全企划部的历史简称
entries.en: The archive contains a document bearing the ANSP initials.
entries.zh: 档案中有一份印着国家安全企划部缩写的文件。

entries.en: Ansu carried the folding screen into the hall.
entries.zh: 安苏把折叠屏风搬进大厅。

entries.en: The clinic uses an answering service outside office hours.
entries.zh: 诊所下班后使用代接电话服务。

entries.meaningZh: antefixae：瓦当或檐端饰物，antefixa的复数
entries.en: The museum displayed terracotta antefixae from an old roof.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了旧屋顶上的陶制檐端饰物。

entries.en: The historical pharmacy glossary labels antanacathartic as treatment-related.
entries.zh: 历史药学词汇表把antanacathartic标为治疗相关形容词。

entries.meaningZh: Antar：原资料中的历史制剂名称
entries.en: The pharmacy archive preserves an Antar ampoule label.
entries.zh: 药学档案保存着一张Antar安瓿标签。

entries.en: The skull diagram labels the antarticulare near the jaw joint.
entries.zh: 头骨示意图在颌关节附近标出了前关节骨。

entries.meaningZh: ANTEC：Annual Technical Conference，技术年会名称缩写
entries.en: The bibliography includes an ANTEC conference paper.
entries.zh: 参考文献中有一篇技术年会论文。

entries.en: The old anatomical plate labels the frontal horn antecornu.
entries.zh: 旧解剖图版把前角标为antecornu。

entries.en: The fish diagram marks the antedorsal region.
entries.zh: 鱼类示意图标出了前背部区域。

entries.meaningZh: antelocation：前置或向前移位的旧称
entries.en: The historical glossary uses antelocation for a forward displacement.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表用antelocation表示向前移位。

entries.en: The circuit table has a column for antenna inductance.
entries.zh: 电路表有一栏列出天线电感。

entries.en: The historical glossary explains antereisis as resistance or opposition.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把antereisis解释为抵抗或对抗。

entries.en: The old physiology glossary contrasts antergy with cooperative action.
entries.zh: 旧生理学词汇表把拮抗作用与协同作用作了对比。

entries.en: The anatomical diagram labels the antero-external surface.
entries.zh: 解剖示意图标出了前外侧面。

entries.en: The dental-history glossary includes anteroclusion.
entries.zh: 牙科史词汇表列有前咬合关系这一旧名。

entries.en: The anatomical diagram marks the anteroparietal area.
entries.zh: 解剖示意图标出了顶前区域。

entries.en: The anatomy glossary defines anteflexion as a forward bending.
entries.zh: 解剖学词汇表把前屈解释为向前弯曲。

entries.meaningZh: anthanthrene：二苯并芘类化合物名称
entries.en: The chemical-name index lists anthanthrene among polycyclic compounds.
entries.zh: 化学名称索引把anthanthrene列在多环化合物中。

entries.meaningZh: anthela：一种开展的聚伞状花序
entries.en: The botany diagram labels the spreading inflorescence an anthela.
entries.zh: 植物学示意图把这种开展的花序标为anthela。

entries.meaningZh: anthelotic：用于除鸡眼或胼胝的旧形容词
entries.en: The old pharmacy glossary uses anthelotic for a preparation intended to remove corns.
entries.zh: 旧药学词汇表用anthelotic指拟用于除鸡眼的制剂。

entries.en: The historical medical glossary cross-references anthema to a rash.
entries.zh: 历史医学词汇表把anthema交叉指向皮疹。

entries.meaningZh: anthemidine：洋甘菊定，旧化合物名称
entries.en: The chemical-name index lists anthemidine.
entries.zh: 化学名称索引中列有洋甘菊定。

entries.meaningZh: antheraxanthin：花药黄质，一种类胡萝卜素
entries.en: The pigment chart places antheraxanthin among the carotenoids.
entries.zh: 色素图表把花药黄质列在类胡萝卜素中。

entries.en: The old glossary marks antherpetic as a treatment-related adjective.
entries.zh: 旧词汇表把antherpetic标为治疗相关形容词。

entries.meaningZh: anthiolimine：安锑锂明，原资料中的旧名称
entries.en: The historical drug-name index retains anthiolimine in its original spelling.
entries.zh: 历史药名索引保留了anthiolimine的原拼写。

entries.meaningZh: 离口目（纤毛虫的一类分类名称）
entries.en: The diagram places Apostomatida in a separate branch of the ciliate classification.
entries.zh: 图中将离口目列在纤毛虫分类的一个独立分支上。

entries.meaningZh: 储藏室；酒窖（拉丁语及历史用语）
entries.en: The inventory lists the wine jars under the heading apotheca.
entries.zh: 清单把酒罐列在“储藏室”这一项下。

entries.en: The merchant's catalogue describes apou as a cloth sold by the bolt.
entries.zh: 商人的目录把中国夏布描述为一种按匹出售的布料。

entries.en: The APPA programme included a discussion of independent publishing.
entries.zh: 亚太出版商联合会的活动安排中包括一场关于独立出版的讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 明显的；显而易见的（采用规范英语词形 apparent）
entries.en: Her disappointment was apparent from the moment she read the letter.
entries.zh: 她读到那封信时，失望之情便显而易见。

entries.meaningZh: 忧虑；担忧（采用规范拼写 apprehension）
entries.en: He approached the interview with a mixture of excitement and apprehension.
entries.zh: 他怀着既兴奋又担忧的心情去参加面试。

entries.en: The translator retained appendalgia in the quotation and explained it in a footnote.
entries.zh: 译者在引文中保留了“阑尾痛”这一旧术语，并在脚注中加以解释。

entries.en: The historical glossary defines appendiclausis as obstruction of the appendix.
entries.zh: 这本历史术语表将appendiclausis解释为阑尾阻塞。

entries.meaningZh: 阑尾粘连分离术（术语名称）
entries.en: Appendicolysis appears in the book's historical index of surgical terms.
entries.zh: 该书的历史外科术语索引中列有“阑尾粘连分离术”。

entries.meaningZh: 易身妄想（旧精神医学术语）
entries.en: The essay discusses appersonification as a term found in older psychiatric writing.
entries.zh: 这篇文章讨论了旧精神医学著作中出现的“易身妄想”一词。

entries.en: The form uses appl. as an abbreviation for application.
entries.zh: 这张表格用appl.作为application（申请）的缩写。

entries.meaningZh: 苹果籽（规范写法 apple seeds）
entries.en: She picked the apple seeds out before adding the fruit to the salad.
entries.zh: 她先挑出了苹果籽，再把果肉加入沙拉。

entries.en: The school archive still contains lesson plans created in AppleWorks.
entries.zh: 学校档案中仍保存着用AppleWorks制作的教案。

entries.meaningZh: 应用软件（较少见的用语）
entries.en: The old computing manual separates applicationware from the operating system.
entries.zh: 这本旧计算机手册将应用软件与操作系统分开介绍。

entries.meaningZh: 趋避冲突；同一目标既有吸引力又令人退缩的冲突
entries.en: The character's approach-avoidance conflict explains why she keeps postponing the move.
entries.zh: 这个人物的趋避冲突解释了她为何不断推迟搬家。

entries.meaningZh: 恰当；合适（采用规范名词 appropriateness）
entries.en: We discussed the appropriateness of using informal language in the invitation.
entries.zh: 我们讨论了在邀请函中使用非正式措辞是否合适。

entries.meaningZh: 近似值；近似法（采用规范拼写 approximation）
entries.en: The dotted line gives a useful approximation of the overall trend.
entries.zh: 虚线提供了对总体趋势的一个有用近似。

entries.meaningZh: 语法缺失；失语法症（例句采用规范术语 agrammatism）
entries.en: The chapter distinguishes agrammatism from occasional grammatical mistakes.
entries.zh: 本章区分了失语法症与偶尔出现的语法错误。

entries.meaningZh: APRI；天冬氨酸氨基转移酶与血小板计数比值指数
entries.en: The report spells out APRI at its first occurrence.
entries.zh: 报告在APRI首次出现时写出了它的全称。

entries.en: The conference badge identified Maya as an APRN.
entries.zh: 会议胸牌标明玛雅是一名高级实践注册护士。

entries.en: The library catalogue lists aprofene in an index of historical drug names.
entries.zh: 图书馆目录在历史药物名称索引中列有阿普罗芬。

entries.meaningZh: 贴切；恰当（例句采用标准名词 aptness）
entries.en: Everyone admired the aptness of the final image in her poem.
entries.zh: 大家都很欣赏她诗中最后一个意象的贴切。

entries.meaningZh: A/in²；安培每平方英寸（电流密度单位）
entries.en: The old chart gives current density in amperes per square inch.
entries.zh: 这张旧图表以安培每平方英寸表示电流密度。

entries.en: The museum inventory expands APSR as airborne pulse search radar.
entries.zh: 博物馆清单将APSR展开为“机载脉冲搜索雷达”。

entries.en: Ms Apted left a handwritten message beside the returned keys.
entries.zh: 阿普特女士在归还的钥匙旁留了一张手写便条。

entries.en: The aptly named Quiet Corner became her favourite place to read.
entries.zh: 这个恰如其名的“安静角落”成了她最喜欢的阅读地点。

entries.meaningZh: APV；原记录中的前后位投影标签
entries.en: The archive labels the front-to-back projection APV.
entries.zh: 档案将这张前后位投影标为APV。

entries.en: The leaflet displays the APY beside the account name.
entries.zh: 宣传单在账户名称旁标出了年百分比收益率。

entries.meaningZh: AQ；南极洲的两字母地区代码
entries.en: The database uses AQ as the code for Antarctica.
entries.zh: 该数据库用AQ作为南极洲的代码。

entries.en: The star chart uses Aql as the abbreviation for Aquila.
entries.zh: 这张星图用Aql作为天鹰座的缩写。

entries.meaningZh: AQMD；空气质量管理区或其管理机构
entries.en: The AQMD notice included a date for public comments.
entries.zh: 空气质量管理机构的通知中列出了公众意见的提交日期。

entries.en: The glossary explains that aq. stands for aqueous.
entries.zh: 术语表解释说，aq.是aqueous（水溶液的）的缩写。

entries.en: The editor kept aquage in the historical word list but added a modern gloss.
entries.zh: 编辑在历史词表中保留了aquage，并补上了现代释义。

entries.meaningZh: 海绿色的（拉丁语颜色词）
entries.en: The specimen list uses aquamarinus as a Latin colour description.
entries.zh: 标本目录用aquamarinus作为拉丁语颜色描述。

entries.meaningZh: 水霉素；aquamycin，旧论文中的一种抗生素名称
entries.en: The historian traced aquamycin to a paper published in 1959.
entries.zh: 历史研究者把水霉素这一名称追溯到一篇发表于1959年的论文。

entries.meaningZh: Aquapolis；水上城市或水上建筑项目名称
entries.en: The model of Aquapolis occupied an entire display case.
entries.zh: Aquapolis水上城市的模型占据了整个展示柜。

entries.meaningZh: 水上体操；水中健身体操
entries.en: The pool timetable lists aquathenics on Tuesday mornings.
entries.zh: 游泳池的课程表将水上体操安排在每周二上午。

entries.meaningZh: Aquilae；天鹰座拉丁语名称的属格形式
entries.en: The catalogue identifies the star as Alpha Aquilae.
entries.zh: 目录将这颗恒星标为天鹰座α星。

entries.meaningZh: 取得；获得（acquire的过去式或过去分词 acquired）
entries.en: The museum acquired the collection from a local family.
entries.zh: 博物馆从当地一个家庭手中购得了这批藏品。

entries.meaningZh: aquo-；表示配位水的构词成分
entries.en: The lecture explains the prefix aquo- before introducing the complex names.
entries.zh: 讲座先解释表示配位水的aquo-前缀，再介绍配合物的名称。

entries.meaningZh: 水溶发光；水合发光（旧物理化学术语）
entries.en: Aquoluminescence appears among the historical terms discussed in the review.
entries.zh: 这篇综述讨论的历史术语中包括水溶发光。

entries.meaningZh: 耳迷路淋巴液（旧拉丁医学用语）
entries.en: The translator explains aquula in a note on the book's anatomical vocabulary.
entries.zh: 译者在介绍该书解剖学词汇的注释中解释了aquula。

entries.en: The exhibition brings together photographers from across the Arab world.
entries.zh: 这次展览汇集了来自阿拉伯世界各地的摄影师。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉伯式图案；蔓藤花纹（例句采用 arabesque）
entries.en: An intricate arabesque surrounds the title on the cover.
entries.zh: 封面标题周围环绕着精细的阿拉伯式花纹。

entries.meaningZh: 哈满尔；arabine，harman这一生物碱名称的别称
entries.en: The glossary gives arabine as another name for harman.
entries.zh: 词汇表将arabine列为哈满尔的另一个名称。

entries.meaningZh: 使阿拉伯化（Arabize的英式拼法之一）
entries.en: The publisher chose to Arabise the place names in the translated edition.
entries.zh: 出版社选择在译本中将地名阿拉伯化。

entries.meaningZh: 喜爱阿拉伯文化的人；亲阿拉伯人士
entries.en: As an Arabophile, he built a personal library of Arabic poetry in translation.
entries.zh: 作为阿拉伯文化爱好者，他收藏了许多阿拉伯诗歌译本。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉卡蒂风（地方性风名）
entries.en: The travel diary mentions the aracaty in its description of the local weather.
entries.zh: 这本旅行日记在描述当地天气时提到了阿拉卡蒂风。

entries.meaningZh: 蜘蛛指（趾）；手指或脚趾异常细长的形态
entries.en: The glossary gives arachnodactylia as a term for unusually long, slender digits.
entries.zh: 术语表将arachnodactylia解释为手指或脚趾异常细长的形态。

entries.meaningZh: 蜘蛛指（趾）（规范词形 arachnodactyly）
entries.en: The index directs readers from long fingers to arachnodactyly.
entries.zh: 索引将查阅“细长手指”的读者引向“蜘蛛指”这一条目。

entries.meaningZh: Arae；天坛座拉丁语名称的属格形式
entries.en: The star list includes a separate entry for Mu Arae.
entries.zh: 恒星表为天坛座μ星单列了一个条目。

entries.en: The old map abbreviates Aragón as Arag.
entries.zh: 这张旧地图将阿拉贡缩写为Arag.。

entries.en: The historical dictionary places araiocardia under slow heartbeat.
entries.zh: 这部历史词典将araiocardia列在“心搏徐缓”项下。

entries.meaningZh: 芳烷基（采用规范词形 aralkyl）
entries.en: The glossary distinguishes aralkyl from aryl.
entries.zh: 术语表区分了芳烷基与芳基。

entries.meaningZh: 荒布；一种可食用海藻的名称
entries.en: She sprinkled a little arame over the rice salad.
entries.zh: 她在米饭沙拉上撒了一点荒布海藻。

entries.meaningZh: 蛛网般的；像蛛网一样纤薄的（旧文学用法）
entries.en: The morning light passed through an araneous curtain.
entries.zh: 晨光穿过了一道蛛网般纤薄的帘幕。

entries.meaningZh: Aransas；阿兰萨斯（地名，用于保护区名称）
entries.en: We stopped at Aransas National Wildlife Refuge to watch the birds.
entries.zh: 我们在阿兰萨斯国家野生动物保护区停留观鸟。

entries.en: The diagram expands ARAS in a box beside the brainstem.
entries.zh: 图中在脑干旁的方框内写出了上行网状激活系统这一全称。

entries.meaningZh: ARAT；自动随机存取传送（旧技术记录中的缩写）
entries.en: The manual defines ARAT before listing the transport functions.
entries.zh: 手册先解释ARAT所指的自动随机存取传送，再列出传送功能。

entries.en: The archive contains an ARATS press release in both Chinese and English.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着一份中英双语的海峡两岸关系协会新闻稿。

entries.meaningZh: 阿鲍霉素（旧抗生素名称）
entries.en: The reference index lists arbomycin among historical antibiotic names.
entries.zh: 参考索引将阿鲍霉素列在历史抗生素名称中。

entries.meaningZh: 装在心轴上加工；心轴装夹
entries.en: The apprenticeship handbook includes a section on arboring.
entries.zh: 这本学徒手册包含一个关于心轴装夹的章节。

entries.meaningZh: 弧有向图（旧计算机词表中的名称）
entries.en: The textbook includes a separate diagram labelled arc-digraph.
entries.zh: 这本教科书单列了一幅标为“弧有向图”的图。

entries.en: They rented a small flat in Arcachon for the summer.
entries.zh: 他们在阿卡雄租了一套小公寓过夏天。

entries.meaningZh: 更晦涩的；更深奥的（采用比较形式 more arcane）
entries.en: The second chapter deals with the more arcane aspects of medieval law.
entries.zh: 第二章讨论中世纪法律中更加深奥的方面。

entries.en: The maintenance report records an instance of arcback.
entries.zh: 维修报告记录了一次回弧现象。

entries.en: The illustrated guide compares the shells of several members of Arcellinida.
entries.zh: 这本图解指南比较了表壳虫目几个成员的壳。

entries.en: The detective finally came face to face with her arch-nemesis.
entries.zh: 那位侦探终于与自己的宿敌正面相遇。

entries.en: The faded map uses Archaeoid for its oldest rock unit.
entries.zh: 这张褪色的地图用Archaeoid标示其最古老的岩石单元。

entries.meaningZh: 原双星体（旧细胞学术语）
entries.en: The caption identifies the paired structure as an archamphiaster.
entries.zh: 图注将这一成对结构标为原双星体。

entries.meaningZh: 自然发生；生物自生说（历史用语）
entries.en: The essay places archegenesis in the history of ideas about the origin of life.
entries.zh: 文章将自然发生说置于生命起源观念的发展史中讨论。

entries.en: Her interest in archeochemistry began with a lecture on ancient pottery.
entries.zh: 一场关于古代陶器的讲座激发了她对考古化学的兴趣。

entries.meaningZh: Archer Daniels Midland；阿彻丹尼尔斯米德兰公司
entries.en: The report lists Archer Daniels Midland among the companies discussed.
entries.zh: 报告将阿彻丹尼尔斯米德兰列在所讨论的公司之中。

entries.meaningZh: 非生物起源；自然发生（历史术语）
entries.en: The historian distinguishes the old concept of archigenesis from modern accounts of evolution.
entries.zh: 历史学者区分了旧时的自然发生概念与现代进化论述。

entries.meaningZh: 原始核；初核（旧细胞学名称）
entries.en: The old plate labels the central body archikaryon.
entries.zh: 这幅旧图版将中央结构标为原始核。

entries.en: The glossary links archistome to the more familiar term blastopore.
entries.zh: 术语表将archistome与更常见的术语blastopore（胚孔）相联系。

entries.meaningZh: 肛门膀胱瘘（旧医学名称）
entries.en: The translator adds a plain-language gloss after archocystosyrinx.
entries.zh: 译者在“肛门膀胱瘘”这一旧术语后补上了通俗解释。

entries.meaningZh: 肛门或直肠黏液溢（旧医学术语）
entries.en: The historical index files archorrhea under rectal discharge.
entries.zh: 历史索引将archorrhea归在直肠分泌物相关条目之下。

entries.meaningZh: 肛门或直肠狭窄（旧医学术语）
entries.en: The editor preserves archostegnosis in the quotation but modernises the explanation.
entries.zh: 编辑在引文中保留了archostegnosis，但将“肛门或直肠狭窄”的解释改为现代措辞。

entries.en: The Spanish pottery guide uses arcilla for the clay shaped by the potter.
entries.zh: 这本西班牙语陶艺指南用arcilla指陶工塑形所用的黏土。

entries.meaningZh: Arcola；旧锅炉名称或型号标签
entries.en: The building inventory lists an Arcola boiler in the basement.
entries.zh: 建筑清单记载地下室有一台Arcola锅炉。

entries.meaningZh: 子囊霉素（例句采用规范名称 ascomycin）
entries.en: The catalogue gives ascomycin a separate entry in the drug-name index.
entries.zh: 目录在药物名称索引中为子囊霉素单列了一项。

entries.en: The student checked that arcsin of zero is zero.
entries.zh: 学生核实了零的反正弦值为零。

entries.en: The veins run arcuately toward the edge of the leaf.
entries.zh: 叶脉呈弧形伸向叶缘。

entries.en: The report defines ARD as acute respiratory disease.
entries.zh: 报告将ARD定义为急性呼吸道疾病。

entries.meaningZh: 电偶测热计（旧仪器名称）
entries.en: The museum label describes the ardometer as a thermoelectric measuring instrument.
entries.zh: 博物馆标签将电偶测热计描述为一种热电测量仪器。

entries.en: The technician examined the damaged component for signs of arc-through.
entries.zh: 技术人员检查了受损部件，查看是否有电弧贯穿的迹象。

entries.meaningZh: 液体比重计（采用规范词形 areometer）
entries.en: An areometer stood beside the other measuring instruments in the display case.
entries.zh: 展示柜中的液体比重计旁边摆放着其他测量仪器。

entries.meaningZh: 成片的；斑片状的（拉丁语描述形式）
entries.en: The glossary explains areatus as a Latin descriptive form meaning arranged in patches.
entries.zh: 术语表将areatus解释为表示“呈斑片状”的拉丁语描述形式。

entries.en: The botanical chart places the palms under Arecales.
entries.zh: 植物分类图将棕榈类植物列在槟榔目之下。

entries.en: Arecolone appears in the appendix rather than in the main discussion.
entries.zh: 槟榔酮出现在附录中，而未出现在正文讨论中。

entries.meaningZh: AREE；海军部区域电气工程师（旧职务缩写）
entries.en: The archived letter identifies its recipient as the AREE.
entries.zh: 这封存档信件将收件人标为海军部区域电气工程师。

entries.meaningZh: AREI；旧房地产与股票机构相关资格缩写
entries.en: The membership register prints AREI after the applicant's name.
entries.zh: 会员名册在申请人姓名后印有AREI。

entries.meaningZh: 阿雷纳霉素；戊烯内酯（采用规范名称 arenaemycin）
entries.en: The reference index lists arenaemycin under its antibiotic names.
entries.zh: 参考索引将阿雷纳霉素列在抗生素名称项下。

entries.meaningZh: 东陵石；砂金石（采用规范拼写 aventurine）
entries.en: The pendant contains a polished piece of green aventurine.
entries.zh: 这枚吊坠镶有一块抛光的绿色东陵石。

entries.en: The dictionary marks areocardia as an older term for a slow heartbeat.
entries.zh: 词典将areocardia标注为心搏徐缓的旧称。

entries.meaningZh: 比重瓶比重计（旧仪器名称）
entries.en: The equipment catalogue includes a drawing of an areopyknometer.
entries.zh: 仪器目录中收录了一幅比重瓶比重计的图。

entries.meaningZh: 逐渐干燥的；趋于干枯的
entries.en: The botanical description calls the ageing leaves arescent.
entries.zh: 这段植物学描述称逐渐老化的叶片正趋于干枯。

entries.en: Professor Arévalo stayed after the lecture to answer questions.
entries.zh: 阿雷瓦洛教授在讲座结束后留下来回答问题。

entries.meaningZh: Arfonad；阿福那特，旧药品商品名
entries.en: The archival catalogue records Arfonad as a proprietary drug name.
entries.zh: 档案目录将阿福那特登记为药品商品名。

entries.meaningZh: 废用性弱视（旧医学术语）
entries.en: The historical glossary places argamblyopia among older terms for impaired vision.
entries.zh: 这本历史术语表将废用性弱视列在视力障碍的旧名称之中。

entries.meaningZh: 角膜缘溃疡（旧医学术语）
entries.en: The historical glossary defines argema as an ulcer at the edge of the cornea.
entries.zh: 这本历史术语表将argema解释为角膜边缘的溃疡。

entries.meaningZh: 嗜银细胞瘤（旧病理学名称）
entries.en: The archive indexes the paper under the term argentaffinoma.
entries.zh: 档案将这篇论文编在“嗜银细胞瘤”这一术语之下。

entries.meaningZh: 银的（拉丁语 argentum 的属格形式）
entries.en: The glossary explains argenti as the Latin genitive of argentum.
entries.zh: 术语表解释说，argenti是拉丁语argentum（银）的属格形式。

entries.meaningZh: 阿根廷（采用规范国家名称 Argentina）
entries.en: Her photographs of Argentina filled the last two pages of the album.
entries.zh: 相册的最后两页贴满了她在阿根廷拍摄的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 喷雾器（采用规范普通名词 sprayer）
entries.en: The gardener put the empty sprayer back on the shelf.
entries.zh: 园丁把空喷雾器放回了架子上。

entries.meaningZh: 白陶土；黏土（旧拉丁药学或材料名称）
entries.en: The materials list uses argilla for the pale clay in the collection.
entries.zh: 这份材料清单用argilla指收藏中的浅色黏土。

entries.en: The survey describes the lower soil layer as argillous.
entries.zh: 调查报告将下层土壤描述为含黏土的。

entries.meaningZh: 精氨酸琥珀酸尿症（采用规范病名 argininosuccinic aciduria）
entries.en: The genetics textbook includes argininosuccinic aciduria in its index.
entries.zh: 遗传学教科书的索引中列有精氨酸琥珀酸尿症。

entries.meaningZh: 阿格霉素；金船霉素（旧抗生素名称）
entries.en: The catalogue preserves argomycin in its list of historical antibiotic names.
entries.zh: 目录在历史抗生素名称表中保留了阿格霉素。

entries.meaningZh: 争论；提出理由（采用规范动词 argue）
entries.en: They argue about the ending of the novel every time the book club meets.
entries.zh: 每次读书会聚会，他们都会争论那部小说的结局。

entries.meaningZh: ARGUSS；自动例行程序生成与更新系统（旧计算机缩写）
entries.en: The old manual expands ARGUSS in its list of system names.
entries.zh: 这本旧手册在系统名称表中写出了ARGUSS的全称。

entries.en: The editor distinguishes argyraemia from other historical terms involving silver.
entries.zh: 编辑将银血症与其他涉及银的历史术语区分开来。

entries.en: The medical-history essay explains the older term argyriasis.
entries.zh: 这篇医学史文章解释了“银质沉着病”这一旧术语。

entries.en: The handwritten mineral list includes argyrite beside several other silver minerals.
entries.zh: 手写矿物清单在几种其他银矿物旁列有辉银矿。

entries.meaningZh: 嗜银性；银易染性（采用规范词形 argyrophilia）
entries.en: The glossary explains argyrophilia in its section on staining terminology.
entries.zh: 术语表在染色术语一节中解释了嗜银性。

entries.meaningZh: 无嗅脑畸形（旧医学名称）
entries.en: Arhinencephalia appears in the historical index of anatomical abnormalities.
entries.zh: 无嗅脑畸形出现在解剖异常的历史术语索引中。
